violation_type.title: Not allowing Licensing staff to inspect or investigate may result in enforcement action (26 TAC §745.8425)
violation_type.short_title: Not allowing Licensing staff to inspect or investigate may result in enforcement action
violation_type.typical_finding: Upon arrival to the center, the center director closed and locked the door after finding out that there was an investigation on the operation and did not allow the investigator in the operation until the investigator knocked on the door after five minutes.
